originalAlarm.description: Use of memory after it is freed

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: When ENABLE_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP is true, delete_eth_table(ch) frees both ch->ifname and ch itself (lines 15-16). The for loop at line 43 then accesses ch->next after ch has been freed, which is a use-after-free. The alarm fires at line 43 (the for loop header) exactly where the freed pointer is dereferenced. KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for bc0ffc0e971.c documents exactly this UseAfterFree — 'ch->next' dereferences already freed memory when FEATURE_CLEAN_UP is enabled. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: When FEATURE_CLEAN_UP is false, delete_eth_table is a no-op so no memory is freed and no use-after-free occurs. The presence condition ENABLE_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP==true is correct.
